note: Class: self-application, not yet attackable. The strongest form of the rival: it grants appearances and denies that an appearance of change is itself a change, i.e. it denies STMT-OPINION-IS-A-MOTION, so the retorsion would beg the question and no refutes relation is recorded. Missing: McTaggart's own answer (The Nature of Existence II, ch. 44, to source) and an argument that judging or perceiving is a reduction from potency to act (DISAMB-MOTION).
